Senses.Explanation: To awaken by oneself without instruction is admitted only in the inherited contrast concerning the time before King Awesome Voice; after that boundary, the records demand instruction’s confirmation. A claim of solitary discovery becomes a lineage test: the same wording is conditionally allowed before the imagined first teacher and rejected afterward as unsupported. The corpus does not simply praise independence. Its recurrent contrast makes historical position and confirmation part of the term’s deployment.
